notes: Author content: the continuing first paragraph criticizes the absence of a definition of a functor from (semi) simplicial sets to n-groupoids, calling its geometric intuition clear and a theory omitting it canularesque. This is reported as the author’s position, not a verified mathematical conclusion.

Author qualifications and question: Peut-être introduces the proposed wish-list/axiomatic-description route. The author also writes à la rigueur for an existence-and-uniqueness theorem. The overwritten pour/qui and the later inserted qui permette leave the written construction qui, soit donne/donner … soit qui permette; it has not been regularized.

Author content and qualifications in the second paragraph: n’ayant pas compris explicitly says he has not understood Segal’s idea in the correspondent’s last letter; mais peu importe qualifies the subsequent discussion. For strict Picard n-categories, he asks for an (n+1)-category (n+1)-equivalent to complexes of length n, then asks D’accord ? The two n+1 occurrences were separately inspected as ink.

Numbering and letter state: the author’s page number is 2; the later pencil foliation is 147. H’s page 146 is witness metadata, not an additional author number to import. No date, salutation or signature is on this sheet; the final Je te remercie continues the letter.

Scope of checks: every inline mathematical expression and its placement was read, but no theorem, equivalence, proof step or counterexample was mathematically checked. The checks list is therefore empty. Ordinary transcription inspection is not recorded as proof verification.

Residual matters: five C doubts are retained (old vant, possible re, old qu’on, old pour and donne/donner); three C doubts are resolved (barred m, live dont on and live qui). H’s separate doubt on essayant is resolved. A possible low comma after longueur is newly marked; its intentional status remains uncertain. The written qu’ils is retained without declaring it a grammatical slip.

coverage: One whole-page layout view was followed by exactly one view of half a and then exactly one view of half b. All 27 physical prose lines were read against both complete witnesses, including every agreed word and sign, capitalization, accents and absent accents, punctuation, abbreviations, all inline n/2/n+1 expressions, physical wraps and all correction states. Seven distinct unresolved places then received one tight crop each through crop.py, with the slanted écri correction rotated by 3 degrees; none was recropped. The page has two independent prose paragraphs, three interlinear insertions, four underlying/cancelled text loci, one possible live replacement ending, an author page number and archive foliation. No display, diagram, drawing, independent author margin note, heading, date, salutation or signature was found. H leaves the uncertain older words under dont on and qui untranscribed and explicitly does not supply the possible re. Both witnesses omit the newly retained uncertain low mark after longueur. All states are represented in reading.tex; author numbering is preserved and archive foliation is a TeX comment only.
